run_summary: census: exp-8 embedding and coverage code with the exp-9 class_draw (focal seed on its own RNG stream, 15 nearest non-seed pool patients of the focal seed, exp-8 random patients replayed). diagnostic_rules (4885319, scratch script ~/exp9_diag/diag.py, not committed): recomputed deep/concentrated/random coverage per validation patient, decomposed each allocation's improvement into focal-cell and other-cell contributions, and evaluated alternative nested rules (farthest-point, greedy facility-location on the training pool, fully concentrated deep arm = focal seed + 4 nearest). diagnostic_fixed_count (4885321, scratch script ~/exp9_diag/diag2.py, not committed): clustered = focal seed + 19 nearest pool patients vs dispersed = focal seed + 19 greedy facility-location picks, with rho = (r_clustered - r_dispersed) / (r_deep - r_random), within-cohort mean pairwise distance, and focal-site shares.
